fixer.title: agentHost: park sessions whose provider cannot vouch for them until its catalog becomes readable

introducer.title: agentHost: centralize session and chat catalog metadata

cases.mechanism: Dirty provider-unavailable sessions remained eligible forever, repeating per-session database opens and source resolution every periodic pass.
cases.symptom: Production logs showed dozens of older sessions repeatedly reopened; the representative test models 6,000 database opens per hour for 110 sessions.
cases.fixedBehavior: Unavailable-provider rows are attempted once and excluded from normal periodic passes until a provider-readable wake or hourly verification releases them.
cases.evidence: Base line 671 returned providerUnavailable while leaving the row dirty, so `_listDirtySessions` selected it again on each 30-second pass and reconciliation reopened its session database. RIGHT line 704 now parks that row. The added 110-session test demonstrates the call path and multiplicity: 6,000 opens/hour before versus 110 initial opens plus bounded event/hourly retries after, with batches of 50 and concurrency 4.
